families.overlap_explanation: Owns NAM marine and headquarters marked sections, their native exports, and NAM aircraft rows and exports. Other specialist and headquarters sections and other aircraft families remain unchanged. Blender and io_pdx_mesh are needed for rebuilding.

Owns only the marked Azhar Black Harbor palace sections in shared registries. Other ambient actors and entity sections remain unchanged. Blender and io_pdx_mesh are required only to rebuild stale native outputs; previews are opt-in.
Owns only the marked ambient audio section. Authored objects and other builders' landmark sections remain unchanged.

Ainholm owns metadata inside state history plus generated blocks in shared country, party, character, trait, idea, and victory-point localisation; flag directories are shared with the state and regional country pipelines.
Doctrine generation removes migrated doctrine keys from the technology localisation files that are otherwise emitted by the technology builder.

Boundary realignment rewrites province and ownership blocks inside state files created and populated by the state and northern-country builders. Owns definition.csv terrain field 6 for the impassable reactor state 125, preserving every other field and row.
Inner-frontier population and owner metadata layers onto existing state shells; its generated victory-point block and flag directories share engine files with other regional builders.

State-history, outer, and remainder state builders invoke the same building synchronizer after repartitioning provinces; this dedicated owner is the canonical standalone pass. Unit-stack ownership is limited to invalid anchors in Khan provinces 16512, 16523, 16531 and 16639; all other rows remain byte-identical.

The theatre builder owns its declared OSV, STP/YPR, MON and RUS rail connections, the MON-Kalten border connection and MON/Vorkerland supply hubs, including forward depots across the six Khan campaign countries. Unmanaged Nudge records and equivalent existing record formatting are preserved.

The base state-history pass owns generated metadata and selected legacy repairs, then invokes the shared map/buildings synchronizer; later regional builders populate or repartition subsets of the same files.

Northern metadata populates outer state shells and must be reapplied after exclusion-zone repartitioning; its generated victory-point block and flag directories share engine files with other generators.

Outer state shells are later populated by northern and exclusion passes; their generated name block shares the canonical state localisation, and the builder invokes the shared building synchronizer after repartitioning.

Remainder geography and political content share the canonical state-name localisation with other builders and invoke the shared building synchronizer. Political population is reapplied when geographic shells are rebuilt.
Trade-region generation owns only definition.csv continent field 7 and preserves the authoritative province ids, colours, types, coast flags, terrain, row order and line endings.
Technology and doctrine generation deliberately share the combined technology-doctrine localisation files.

Permanent-snow generation owns polar/high-altitude palette conversion outside the IVN geography footprint and preserves land city-mask pixels as urban palette 13; the IVN geography pass owns the northern terrain layers.
Paints palette index 15 only in TARGET_PROVINCES and preserves every byte outside those province pixels. Coastal geography owns its separately enumerated city masks on the same bitmap.
The successor flag pass shares the flat HOI4 flag directories with AIN and regional-country builders; exact generated identifiers are defined in its source manifest.

Owns lowland rasters in provinces 16709, 16710, 16712 and 16802-16808, urban terrain and city/tree masks in provinces 16713-16721 and the compact southern settlement manifest, plus the explicit city and surrounding rural-sector province pixels, bounded province-corner repairs, the 4287-6099 and eight Yubor contact widenings, and the Zshat 10926 connection; owns surface samples and unit-anchor reconciliation for those exact province repairs, and necessary local railway crossings, intersecting normal and DXT5 color cells, and unit anchors for the additions and displaced parent anchors. Owns the mainland Svetlogorye mountain relief, graphical and combat terrain, trees, normals and unit heights in the explicit 27-province mainland Svetlogorye relief mask, with province-clipped foothill and mountain textures and elevation-based rock and snow detail; Nudge splits inside that mask keep its surface while their terrain stays authored. Owns city rasters for the explicit southern urban-growth provinces, unit anchors for the southern Nudge splits 16864-16894 and their donors, and railway reroutes through those splits. Preserves IVN terrain and compatible snow output.

This pass owns terrain, trees, height and normal-map layers inside the explicit IVN/IIA province set, preserves shared land city-mask pixels as urban palette 13, and owns definition.csv terrain field 6 there; trade regions own continent field 7 and terrain_snow owns compatible snow conversion. It stamps the reviewed IVN mainland province geometry into provinces.bmp, appends its new definition rows and coastal flags, owns river pixels outside the authored-river provinces, unit-anchor positions and heights of IVN provinces, and IVN railway segments rerouted through the carved cities.
